label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (XSS) is alert-TP because user input from cookie flows through decode/doSomething/bar into sql variable which is then printed to response via encodeForHTML() - attacker-controlled data reaches the sink expression. Alert 2 (SQL Injection) is alert-TP because the same user input flows directly into the SQL query string at line 70 without parameterization, creating a classic SQL injection vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input extracted from cookie via URLDecoder.decode() at line 60, passed through doSomething() to bar variable at line 104
XSS sink - sql variable containing user input is printed to response via encodeForHTML()
SQL injection sink - bar variable (derived from user input) is directly concatenated into SQL query string
